answer: Split every newcomer's proof through a prism no single forgery can pass. A newcomer must clear three separate checks — a payment route, a device fingerprint, and a live work sample — each verified by a different auditor who never sees the others' verdicts. If one channel fails, the identity drops to its nadir, a zero-trust tier where every job is re-checked and payouts freeze for 30 days. A confirmed fake burns a 1,600 POA bond and is barred for three years, so one hundred fakes risk 160,000 POA. A sable-furred courier with a real trail passes each check once and keeps moving.
